prompt: Award-winning luxury fashion campaign photography for Monavi Collection ("Wear Your Story"). Handsome 28-year-old Indian male fashion model with well-groomed stubble, sharp jawline, dignified confident expression, athletic poised stance, wearing premium bespoke Kurta Pajama crafted from rich Raw Silk, Chanderi Cotton, Linen Silk, Jacquard in shades of Midnight Black, Royal Navy, Ivory Cream. Intricate tailoring, pristine seam lines, tactile fabric weave, authentic drapery and natural folds. Setting: Contemporary architectural studio with midnight slate paneling, stone plinths, and clean geometric lines. Lighting: Structured directional lighting with high-contrast chiaroscuro shadows defining shoulders and jawline. Camera: Shot on Hasselblad H6D-100c medium format, 85mm f/1.4 lens, shallow depth of field, authentic filmic color rendition. Skin & Anatomy: Natural human skin pores, fine skin texture, anatomically perfect hands and fingers, realistic fabric texture, ultra-high resolution 8k. Composition rule: Model is positioned strictly in the right 55% of the frame. The left 45% has clean, unobtrusive architectural backdrop tones for typography overlay. Framing rule: Full-length or three-quarter standing portrait showing the complete ensemble from head to knees and ankles, ensuring BOTH the upper kurta/tunic and lower pajama/churidar/skirt are fully and visibly showcased. Never crop at waist.
